:root {
  color-scheme: light;
  font-family: "Be Vietnam Pro", system-ui, sans-serif;
  color: #0b1c30;
  background: rgb(234, 244, 228);
  --bg: rgb(234, 244, 228);
  --surface: #ffffff;
  --surface-soft: #eff4ff;
  --surface-strong: #e5eeff;
  --text: #0b1c30;
  --muted: #5c6878;
  --line: #dbe5f5;
  --primary: #0b8852;
  --primary-dark: #006c40;
  --blue: #2563eb;
  --orange: #f97316;
  --pink: #e11d48;
  --shadow: 0 18px 45px rgba(15, 23, 42, 0.10);
  --shadow-soft: 0 10px 26px rgba(15, 23, 42, 0.08);
  --radius-xl: 24px;
  --radius-lg: 18px;
  --radius-md: 12px;
}

* { box-sizing: border-box; }
html { scroll-behavior: smooth; }
html, body, #root { max-width: 100%; overflow-x: hidden; }
body { margin: 0; min-width: 320px; background: var(--bg); color: var(--text); overflow-x: hidden; }
a { color: inherit; text-decoration: none; }
button, input, select { font: inherit; }
img { max-width: 100%; display: block; }
.click-card:not(.live-card) { display: block; height: 100%; color: inherit; text-decoration: none; }
.click-card:focus-visible { outline: 3px solid rgba(11, 136, 82, .28); outline-offset: 5px; border-radius: var(--radius-lg); }
.click-card .panel, .click-card .team-card, .click-card .metric-card, .click-card .tournament-card, .click-card.live-card { transition: border-color .2s ease, box-shadow .2s ease, transform .2s ease; }
.click-card:hover .panel, .click-card:hover .team-card, .click-card:hover .metric-card, .click-card:hover .tournament-card, .click-card.live-card:hover { border-color: rgba(11, 136, 82, .32); }

.app-shell { min-height: 100vh; max-width: 100%; overflow-x: hidden; background: radial-gradient(circle at top left, rgba(11, 136, 82, 0.10), transparent 28rem), var(--bg); }
.public-shell { --public-header-height: 78px; padding-top: var(--public-header-height); }
.screen-loader-overlay {
  position: fixed;
  inset: 0;
  z-index: 99999;
  display: grid;
  place-items: center;
  align-content: center;
  gap: 18px;
  background: rgba(234, 244, 228, .72);
  backdrop-filter: blur(8px);
  pointer-events: all;
}
.screen-swap-loader { position: relative; display: grid; place-items: center; width: 160px; height: 160px; }
.screen-swap-loader::before,
.screen-swap-loader::after { content: ""; position: absolute; border-radius: 50%; }
.screen-swap-loader::before { inset: 0; border: 4px dotted rgba(11, 136, 82, .26); animation: loaderSpin 5s linear infinite; }
.screen-swap-loader::after { inset: 17px; border: 3px solid transparent; border-top-color: var(--primary); border-left-color: var(--blue); animation: loaderReverseSpin 1.25s linear infinite; box-shadow: 0 0 28px rgba(11, 136, 82, .20); }
.screen-logo-loader { position: relative; z-index: 1; display: grid; place-items: center; width: 86px; height: 86px; border-radius: 26px; background: rgba(255, 255, 255, .96); box-shadow: 0 18px 45px rgba(11, 136, 82, .28); }
.screen-logo-loader img { width: 64px; height: 64px; object-fit: contain; animation: loaderLogoPulse 1.45s ease-in-out infinite; }
@keyframes loaderSpin { to { transform: rotate(360deg); } }
@keyframes loaderReverseSpin { to { transform: rotate(-360deg); } }
@keyframes loaderLogoPulse { 0%, 100% { transform: scale(.96); } 50% { transform: scale(1.06); } }
.screen-skeleton-shell { width: min(100%, 1280px); margin: 0 auto; display: grid; gap: 18px; }
.screen-skeleton-header,
.screen-skeleton-hero,
.screen-skeleton-grid span,
.route-skeleton-hero,
.route-skeleton-row span {
  border: 1px solid rgba(11, 136, 82, .10);
  background: linear-gradient(90deg, rgba(234, 244, 228, .65), rgba(255, 255, 255, .95), rgba(234, 244, 228, .65));
  background-size: 220% 100%;
  animation: skeletonSweep 1.25s ease-in-out infinite;
  box-shadow: var(--shadow-soft);
}
